# Oath of Remembrance

The Rift didn't just tear the sky. It tore people from their worlds. Every Riftborn is someone who lost everything — a home they can't return to, memories they can't recover, a life that was ripped away mid-sentence. And the Severed Lands does not welcome them. It fears them.

Paladins of the Oath of Remembrance refuse both the fear and the forgetting. They carry what Riftborn can't carry alone. They shield the displaced from a world that distrusts them. And when someone preys on the already-broken, the oath answers.

## Tenets of Remembrance

**Witness.** Acknowledge every loss. No one grieves alone. When a Riftborn speaks of what they lost, you listen. You remember their world's name even if they can't.

**Shield.** Protect those who have already lost too much. The Severed Lands has taken enough from them. It will not take more while you stand.

**Remember.** Carry the names. The worlds. The dead. Oblivion is the only true death — and you have sworn that as long as you live, nothing is truly forgotten.

**Smite.** Those who exploit, hunt, or prey on the displaced receive no quarter. No mercy. No warning. The oath does not negotiate.

## Channel Divinity

*3rd-level Oath of Remembrance feature*

You gain two Channel Divinity options.

**Turn the Cruel.** As an action, you present your holy symbol and speak a name — one of the worlds you carry, or one of the Riftborn you protect. Each enemy within 30 feet that has dealt damage to one of your allies within the last round must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they are frightened of you for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

The oath does not forget who drew blood.

**Oathkeeper's Mark.** As a bonus action, you mark a creature you can see for 1 minute. For the duration, whenever the marked creature deals damage to any ally of yours, it takes radiant damage equal to your Charisma modifier. You can end the mark early as a bonus action. The mark persists even if the creature moves beyond your sight — the oath does not lose track.

## Oath Spells

*3rd-level Oath of Remembrance feature*

| Paladin Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 3rd | Sanctuary, Heroism |
| 5th | Warding Bond, Zone of Truth |
| 9th | Beacon of Hope, Spirit Guardians |
| 13th | Death Ward, Guardian of Faith |
| 17th | Hallow, Commune |

## Aura of Sanctuary

*7th-level Oath of Remembrance feature*

Your presence is a promise. Allies within 10 feet of you have advantage on death saving throws and cannot be frightened. At the edge of death, they know they're not alone. At 18th level, the aura extends to 30 feet.

## In Memoriam

*15th-level Oath of Remembrance feature*

The oath does not let go easily. When an ally within your Aura of Sanctuary drops to 0 hit points and is not killed outright, they do not fall unconscious until the end of their next turn. They can take one final action, one last movement, before their body gives out — enough to strike back, to reach cover, to speak a final word.

Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest.

## Avatar of Remembrance

*20th-level Oath of Remembrance feature*

You become the living embodiment of the oath. Once per long rest, as an action, you transform for 1 minute. A 30-foot aura radiates from you.

While the aura is active, your allies inside cannot drop below 1 hit point. The oath will not let them die. Additionally, enemies inside the aura have disadvantage on attack rolls against any ally below half their hit point maximum. The oath sees what you are doing. The oath does not approve.
